review_scope: Bounded ADR/source/assertion reconsideration; parent gate owns the stale fixed-document expectation edits.

decisions.decision: Retain current substitution recovery as owner-ratified product policy; do not label it a mandatory ISO reader behavior.
decisions.source_basis: §9.5 and §9.8.1 provide information useful for substitution when a program is unavailable, without mandating selection or specifying malformed-stream recovery. §9.9.1/Table 125 specifies embedded program formats/length metadata, not the fallback result.
decisions.current_code_check: Malformed embedded-program refusals reach the copied-descriptor/no-program substitute route; the original refusal is retained and the page remains incomplete. A readable font program with no encoding-reachable glyph remains excluded.
decisions.assertion_check: The promoted exact-xref test unreadable_program_fallback_control_audit::unreadable_program_falls_back_like_absent_program_and_keeps_its_report compares the rendered consumer result against an otherwise identical absent-program control and checks visible ink, literal advance placement, original refusal and incompleteness. Thus prior T11 gap is closed.
decisions.fixed_gate_resolution: PDFIUM-407-0.pdf's two old expected values conflict with the accepted fallback: it now paints 14.633 ink rather than the old 7.791..8.791 band and no longer reports Text operations:197. Keep the implementation; parent should consciously update this one stale document row and preserve the three current FontFile2 refusal reports.
decisions.status: policy remains soundly scoped; fixed-gate expectations stale, not a new conformance defect
